text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Oversized navy rugby knit top with large cream point collar and open short placket, sleeves pushed up; ecru relaxed straight trousers with subtle cargo pocket.  complete trouser hems, no shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: Dark brown leather belt with large silver rounded rectangular buckle, entire belt visible; Short chunky silver curb-link necklace, complete closed chain and clasp; Silver sports watch with dark round dial and metal link bracelet; Silver medium curb-link bracelet with clasp; One broad plain polished silver ring. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 5 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Dark brown leather belt with large silver rounded rectangular buckle, entire belt visible; 2. Short chunky silver curb-link necklace, complete closed chain and clasp; 3. Silver sports watch with dark round dial and metal link bracelet; 4. Silver medium curb-link bracelet with clasp; 5. One broad plain polished silver ring. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
